values.name: WCO first step of two-step export declaration
values.description: WCO first step of two-step export declaration First part of a simplified declaration, in accordance with the WCO Customs Data Model, to Customs by which goods are declared for Customs export procedure based on the 1999 Kyoto Convention.

values.name: Collection payment advice
values.description: Collection payment advice Document/message whereby a bank advises that a collection has been paid, giving details and methods of funds disposal.

values.name: Documentary credit payment advice
values.description: Documentary credit payment advice Document/message whereby a bank advises payment under a documentary credit.

values.name: Documentary credit acceptance advice
values.description: Documentary credit acceptance advice Document/message whereby a bank advises acceptance under a documentary credit.

values.name: Documentary credit negotiation advice
values.description: Documentary credit negotiation advice Document/message whereby a bank advises negotiation under a documentary credit.

values.name: Application for banker's guarantee
values.description: Application for banker's guarantee Document/message whereby a customer requests his bank to issue a guarantee in favour of a nominated party in another country, stating the amount and currency and the specific conditions of the guarantee.

values.name: Banker's guarantee
values.description: Banker's guarantee Document/message in which a bank undertakes to pay out a limited amount of money to a designated party, on conditions stated therein (other than those laid down in the Uniform Customs Practice).

values.name: Documentary credit letter of indemnity
values.description: Documentary credit letter of indemnity Document/message in which a beneficiary of a documentary credit accepts responsibility for non-compliance with the terms and conditions of the credit, and undertakes to refund the money received under the credit, with interest and charges accrued.

values.name: Notification to grid operator of contract termination
values.description: Notification to grid operator of contract termination Notification to the grid operator regarding the termination of a contract.

values.name: Notification to grid operator of metering point changes
values.description: Notification to grid operator of metering point changes Notification to the grid operator about changes regarding a metering point.

values.name: Notification of balance responsible entity change
values.description: Notification of balance responsible entity change Notification of a change of balance responsible entity.

values.name: Preadvice of a credit
values.description: Preadvice of a credit Preadvice indicating a credit to happen in the future.

values.name: Transport equipment profile report
values.description: Transport equipment profile report Report on the profile of transport equipment.

values.name: Request for price and delivery quote, specified end-user
values.description: Request for price and delivery quote, specified end-user Document/message requesting price conditions and delivery conditions under which goods are offered, provided that they are sold to the end-customer specified on the request for quote.

values.name: Request for price quote, ship and debit
values.description: Request for price quote, ship and debit Document/message from a distributor to a supplier requesting price conditions under which goods can be sold by the distributor to the end-customer specified on the request for quote with compensation for loss of inventory value.

values.name: Request for price and delivery quote, ship and debit
values.description: Request for price and delivery quote, ship and debit Document/message from a distributor to a supplier requesting price conditions and delivery conditions under which goods can be sold by the distributor to the end-customer specified on the request for quote with compensation for loss of inventory value.

values.name: Delivery point list.
values.description: Delivery point list. A list of delivery point addresses.

values.name: Transport routing information
values.description: Transport routing information Document specifying the routes for transport between locations.

values.name: Request for delivery quote
values.description: Request for delivery quote Document/message requesting delivery conditions under which goods are offered.

values.name: Request for price and delivery quote
values.description: Request for price and delivery quote Document/message requesting price and delivery conditions under which goods are offered.

values.name: Request for contract price quote
values.description: Request for contract price quote Document/message requesting contractual price conditions under which goods are offered.

values.name: Request for contract price and delivery quote
values.description: Request for contract price and delivery quote Document/message requesting contractual price conditions and contractual delivery conditions under which goods are offered.

values.name: Request for price quote, specified end-customer
values.description: Request for price quote, specified end-customer Document/message requesting price conditions under which goods are offered, provided that they are sold to the end-customer specified on the request for quote.

values.name: Collection order
values.description: Collection order Document/message whereby a bank is instructed (or requested) to handle financial and/or commercial documents in order to obtain acceptance and/or payment, or to deliver documents on such other terms and conditions as may be specified.

values.name: Documents presentation form
values.description: Documents presentation form Document/message whereby a draft or similar instrument and/or commercial documents are presented to a bank for acceptance, discounting, negotiation, payment or collection, whether or not against a documentary credit.

values.name: Identification match
values.description: Identification match Message related to conducting a search for an identification match.

values.name: Payment order
values.description: Payment order Document/message containing information needed to initiate the payment. It may cover the financial settlement for one or more commercial trade transactions. A payment order is an instruction to the ordered bank to arrange for the payment of one specified amount to the beneficiary.

values.name: Extended payment order
values.description: Extended payment order Document/message containing information needed to initiate the payment. It may cover the financial settlement for several commercial trade transactions, which it is possible to specify in a special payments detail part. It is an instruction to the ordered bank to arrange for the payment of one specified amount to the beneficiary.

values.name: Multiple payment order
values.description: Multiple payment order Document/message containing a payment order to debit one or more accounts and to credit one or more beneficiaries.

values.name: Notice that circumstances prevent payment of delivered
values.description: Notice that circumstances prevent payment of delivered goods Message used to inform a supplier that delivered goods cannot be paid due to circumstances which prevent payment.

values.name: Credit advice
values.description: Credit advice Document/message sent by an account servicing institution to one of its account owners, to inform the account owner of an entry which has been or will be credited to its account for a specified amount on the date indicated.

values.name: Extended credit advice
values.description: Extended credit advice Document/message sent by an account servicing institution to one of its account owners, to inform the account owner of an entry that has been or will be credited to its account for a specified amount on the date indicated. It provides extended commercial information concerning the relevant remittance advice.

values.name: Debit advice
values.description: Debit advice Advice on a debit.

values.name: Reversal of debit
values.description: Reversal of debit Reversal of debit accounting entry by bank.

values.name: Reversal of credit
values.description: Reversal of credit Reversal of credit accounting entry by bank.

values.name: Travel ticket
values.description: Travel ticket The document is a ticket giving access to a travel service.

values.name: Documentary credit application
values.description: Documentary credit application Document/message whereby a bank is requested to issue a documentary credit on the conditions specified therein.

values.name: Payment card
values.description: Payment card The document is a credit, guarantee or charge card.

values.name: Ready for transshipment despatch advice
values.description: Ready for transshipment despatch advice Document to advise that the goods ordered are ready for transshipment.

values.name: Pre-packed cross docking despatch advice
values.description: Pre-packed cross docking despatch advice Document by means of which the supplier or consignor informs the buyer, consignee or distribution centre about the despatch of products packed according to the final delivery point requirements which will be moved across a dock in a distribution centre without further handling.

values.name: Intermediate handling cross docking despatch advice
values.description: Intermediate handling cross docking despatch advice Document by means of which the supplier or consignor informs the buyer, consignee or the distribution centre about the despatch of products which will be moved across a dock, de-consolidated and re-consolidated according to final delivery location requirements.

values.name: Documentary credit
values.description: Documentary credit Document/message in which a bank states that it has issued a documentary credit under which the beneficiary is to obtain payment, acceptance or negotiation on compliance with certain terms and conditions and against presentation of stipulated documents and such drafts as may be specified. The credit may or may not be confirmed by another bank.

values.name: Documentary credit notification
values.description: Documentary credit notification Document/message issued by an advising bank in order to transmit a documentary credit to a beneficiary, or to another advising bank.

values.name: Documentary credit transfer advice
values.description: Documentary credit transfer advice Document/message whereby a bank advises that (part of) a documentary credit is being or has been transferred in favour of a second beneficiary.

values.name: Documentary credit amendment notification
values.description: Documentary credit amendment notification Document/message whereby a bank advises that the terms and conditions of a documentary credit have been amended.

values.name: Documentary credit amendment
values.description: Documentary credit amendment Document/message whereby a bank notifies a beneficiary of the details of an amendment to the terms and conditions of a documentary credit.

values.name: Waste disposal report
values.description: Waste disposal report Document/message sent by a shipping agent to an authority for reporting information on waste disposal.

values.name: Remittance advice
values.description: Remittance advice Document/message advising of the remittance of payment.

values.name: Port authority waste disposal report
values.description: Port authority waste disposal report Document/message sent by a port authority to another port authority for reporting information on waste disposal.

values.name: Visa
values.description: Visa An endorsement on a passport or any other recognised travel document indicating that it has been examined and found correct, especially as permitting the holder to enter or leave a country.

values.name: Multiple direct debit request
values.description: Multiple direct debit request Document/message containing a direct debit request to credit one or more accounts and to debit one or more debtors.

values.name: Banker's draft
values.description: Banker's draft Draft drawn in favour of a third party either by one bank on another bank, or by a branch of a bank on its head office (or vice versa) or upon another branch of the same bank. In either case, the draft should comply with the specifications laid down for cheques in the country in which it is to be payable.

values.name: Multiple direct debit
values.description: Multiple direct debit Document/message containing a direct debit to credit one or more accounts and to debit one or more debtors.

values.name: Certificate of disembarkation permission
values.description: Certificate of disembarkation permission Document or message issuing permission to disembark.

values.name: Deratting exemption certificate
values.description: Deratting exemption certificate Document certifying that the object was free of rats when inspected and that it is exempt from a deratting statement.

values.name: Reefer connection order
values.description: Reefer connection order Order to connect a reefer container to a reefer point.

values.name: Bill of exchange
values.description: Bill of exchange Document/message, issued and signed in conformity with the applicable legislation, which contains an unconditional order whereby the drawer directs the drawee to pay a definite sum of money to the payee or to his order, on demand or at a definite time, against the surrender of the document itself.

values.name: Promissory note
values.description: Promissory note Document/message, issued and signed in conformity with the applicable legislation, which contains an unconditional promise whereby the maker undertakes to pay a definite sum of money to the payee or to his order, on demand or at a definite time, against the surrender of the document itself.

values.name: Statement of account message
values.description: Statement of account message Usage of STATAC-message.

values.name: Direct delivery (transport)
values.description: Direct delivery (transport) Document/message ordering the direct delivery of goods/consignment from one means of transport into another means of transport in one movement.

values.name: WCO second step of two-step export declaration
values.description: WCO second step of two-step export declaration Second part of a simplified declaration, in accordance with the WCO Customs Data Model, to Customs by which goods are declared for Customs export procedure based on the 1999 Kyoto Convention.

values.name: WCO one-step import declaration
values.description: WCO one-step import declaration Single step declaration, in accordance with the WCO Customs Data Model, to Customs by which goods are declared for Customs import procedure based on the 1999 Kyoto Convention.

values.name: WCO first step of two-step import declaration
values.description: WCO first step of two-step import declaration First part of a simplified declaration, in accordance with the WCO Customs Data Model, to Customs by which goods are declared for Customs import procedure based on the 1999 Kyoto Convention.

values.name: WCO second step of two-step import declaration
values.description: WCO second step of two-step import declaration Second part of a simplified declaration, in accordance with the WCO Customs Data Model, to Customs by which goods are declared for Customs import procedure based on the 1999 Kyoto Convention.

values.name: Previous transport document
values.description: Previous transport document Identification of the previous transport document.

values.name: Insurance certificate
values.description: Insurance certificate Document/message issued to the insured certifying that insurance has been effected and that a policy has been issued. Such a certificate for a particular cargo is primarily used when good are insured under the terms of a floating or an open policy; at the request of the insured it can be exchanged for a policy.

values.name: Special requirements permit related to the transport of
values.description: Special requirements permit related to the transport of cargo A permit related to a transport document granting the transport of cargo under the conditions as specifically required.

values.name: Dangerous Goods Notification for Tanker vessel
values.description: Dangerous Goods Notification for Tanker vessel Dangerous Goods Notification for a vessel carrying liquid cargo in bulk.

values.name: Dangerous Goods Notification for non-tanker vessel
values.description: Dangerous Goods Notification for non-tanker vessel Dangerous Goods Notification for a vessel carrying cargo other than bulk liquid cargo.

values.name: WCO Conveyance Arrival Report
values.description: WCO Conveyance Arrival Report Declaration, in accordance with the WCO Customs Data Model, to Customs regarding the conveyance arriving in a Customs territory.

values.name: WCO Conveyance Departure Report
values.description: WCO Conveyance Departure Report Declaration, in accordance with the WCO Customs Data Model, to Customs regarding the conveyance departing a Customs territory.

values.name: Accounting voucher
values.description: Accounting voucher A document/message justifying an accounting entry.

values.name: Self billed debit note
values.description: Self billed debit note A document which indicates that the customer is claiming debit in a self billing environment.

values.name: Military Identification Card
values.description: Military Identification Card The official document used for military personnel on travel orders, substituting a passport.

values.name: Re-Entry Permit
values.description: Re-Entry Permit A permit to re-enter a country.

values.name: Insurance policy
values.description: Insurance policy Document/message issued by the insurer evidencing an agreement to insure and containing the conditions of the agreement concluded whereby the insurer undertakes for a specific fee to indemnify the insured for the losses arising out of the perils and accidents specified in the contract.

values.name: Refugee Permit
values.description: Refugee Permit Document identifying a refugee recognized by a country.

values.name: Forwarder�s credit note
values.description: Forwarder�s credit note Document/message for providing credit information to the relevant party.

values.name: Original accounting voucher
values.description: Original accounting voucher To indicate that the document/message justifying an accounting entry is original.

values.name: Copy accounting voucher
values.description: Copy accounting voucher To indicate that the document/message justifying an accounting entry is a copy.

values.name: Pro-forma accounting voucher
values.description: Pro-forma accounting voucher To indicate that the document/message justifying an accounting entry is pro-forma.

values.name: International Ship Security Certificate
values.description: International Ship Security Certificate A certificate on ship security issued based on the International code for the Security of Ships and of Port facilities (ISPS code).

values.name: Interim International Ship Security Certificate
values.description: Interim International Ship Security Certificate An interim certificate on ship security issued basis under the International code for the Security of Ships and of Port facilities (ISPS code).

values.name: Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP) Certificate
values.description: Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP) Certificate Certificate that guarantees quality manufacturing and processing of food products, medications, cosmetics, etc.

values.name: Framework Agreement
values.description: Framework Agreement An agreement between one or more contracting authorities and one or more economic operators, the purpose of which is to establish the terms governing contracts to be awarded during a given period, in particular with regard to price and, where appropriate, the quantity envisaged.

values.name: Insurance declaration sheet (bordereau)
values.description: Insurance declaration sheet (bordereau) A document/message used when an insured reports to his insurer details of individual shipments which are covered by an insurance contract - an open cover or a floating policy - between the parties.

values.name: Transport capacity offer
values.description: Transport capacity offer Offering of capacity for the transport of goods for a date and a route.

values.name: Ship Security Plan
values.description: Ship Security Plan Ship Security Plan (SSP) is a document prepared in terms of the ISPS Code to contribute to the prevention of illegal acts against the ship and its crew.

values.name: Forwarder�s invoice discrepancy report
values.description: Forwarder�s invoice discrepancy report Document/message reporting invoice discrepancies indentified by the forwarder.

values.name: Storage capacity offer
values.description: Storage capacity offer Offering of capacity to store goods.

values.name: Insurer's invoice
values.description: Insurer's invoice Document/message issued by an insurer specifying the cost of an insurance which has been effected and claiming payment therefore.

values.name: Storage capacity request
values.description: Storage capacity request Request for capacity to store goods.

values.name: Transport capacity request
values.description: Transport capacity request Request for capacity for the transport of goods for a date and a route.

values.name: EU Customs declaration for External Community Transit (T1)
values.description: EU Customs declaration for External Community Transit (T1) Customs declaration for goods under the external Community/common transit procedure. This applies to "non-Community goods" ("T1" under EU legislation and EC- EFTA "Transit Convention").

values.name: EU Customs declaration for internal Community Transit (T2)
values.description: EU Customs declaration for internal Community Transit (T2) Customs declaration for goods under the internal Community/common transit procedure. This applies to "Community goods" ("T2" under EU legislation and EC-EFTA "Transit Convention").

values.name: Cover note
values.description: Cover note Document/message issued by an insurer (insurance broker, agent, etc.) to notify the insured that his insurance have been carried out.

values.name: EU Customs declaration for non-fiscal area internal
values.description: EU Customs declaration for non-fiscal area internal Community Transit (T2F) Declaration for goods under the internal Community transit procedure in the context of trade between the "VAT" territory of EU Member States and EU territories where the VAT rules do not apply, such as Canary islands, some French overseas territories, the Channel islands and the Aaland islands, and between those territories. ("T2F" under EU Legislation).

values.name: EU Customs declaration for internal transit to San Marino
values.description: EU Customs declaration for internal transit to San Marino (T2SM) Customs declaration for goods under the internal Community transit procedure between the Community and San Marino. ("T2SM" under EU Legislation).

values.name: EU Customs declaration for mixed consignments (T)
values.description: EU Customs declaration for mixed consignments (T) Customs declaration for goods under the Community/common transit procedure for mixed consignments (i.e. consignments that comprise goods of different statuses, like "T1" and "T2") ("T" under EU Legislation).

values.name: EU Document for establishing the Community status of goods
values.description: EU Document for establishing the Community status of goods (T2L) Form establishing the Community status of goods ("T2L" under EU Legislation).

values.name: EU Document for establishing the Community status of goods
values.description: EU Document for establishing the Community status of goods for certain fiscal purposes (T2LF) Form establishing the Community status of goods in the context of trade between the "VAT" territory of EU Member States and EU territories where the VAT rules do not apply, such as Canary islands, some French overseas territories, the Channel islands and the Aaland islands, and between those territories ("T2LF" under EU Legislation).

values.name: Document for establishing the Customs Status of goods for
values.description: Document for establishing the Customs Status of goods for San Marino (T2LSM) Form establishing the Community status of goods ("T2L" under European Legislation) in the context of trade between the EU and San Marino. ("T2LSM" under EU Legislation).

values.name: Customs declaration for TIR Carnet goods
values.description: Customs declaration for TIR Carnet goods A Customs declaration in which goods move under cover of TIR Carnets.

values.name: Transport Means Security Report
values.description: Transport Means Security Report A document reporting the security status and related information of a means of transport.

values.name: Halal Slaughtering Certificate
values.description: Halal Slaughtering Certificate A certificate verifying that meat has been produced from slaughter in accordance with Islamic laws and practices.

values.name: Forwarding instructions
values.description: Forwarding instructions Document/message issued to a freight forwarder, giving instructions regarding the action to be taken by the forwarder for the forwarding of goods described therein.

values.name: Forwarder's advice to import agent
values.description: Forwarder's advice to import agent Document/message issued by a freight forwarder in an exporting country advising his counterpart in an importing country about the forwarding of goods described therein.

values.name: Forwarder's advice to exporter
values.description: Forwarder's advice to exporter Document/message issued by a freight forwarder informing an exporter of the action taken in fulfillment of instructions received.

values.name: Forwarder's invoice
values.description: Forwarder's invoice Invoice issued by a freight forwarder specifying services rendered and costs incurred and claiming payment therefore.

values.name: Forwarder's certificate of receipt
values.description: Forwarder's certificate of receipt Non-negotiable document issued by a forwarder to certify that he has assumed control of a specified consignment, with irrevocable instructions to send it to the consignee indicated in the document or to hold it at his disposal. E.g. FIATA-FCR.

values.name: Heat Treatment Certificate
values.description: Heat Treatment Certificate A certificate verifying the heat treatment of the product is in conformance with international standards to ensure the product�s healthiness and/or shows the mode of heat treatment indicating the temperature and the amount of time the product or raw material used in the product was treated (such as milk).

values.name: Convention on International Trade in Endangered Species of
values.description: Convention on International Trade in Endangered Species of Wild Fauna and Flora (CITES) Certificate A certificate used in the trade of endangered species in accordance with the CITES convention.

values.name: Free Sale Certificate in the Country of Origin
values.description: Free Sale Certificate in the Country of Origin A certificate confirming that a specified product is free for sale in the country of origin.

values.name: Transit license
values.description: Transit license Document/message issued by the competent body in accordance with transit regulations in force, by which authorization is granted to a party to move articles under customs procedure.

values.name: Veterinary quarantine certificate
values.description: Veterinary quarantine certificate A certification that livestock or animal products, that are either imported or entering free zones, are kept under health supervision for a time period determined by veterinary quarantine instructions.

values.name: Shipping note
values.description: Shipping note (1123) Document/message provided by the shipper or his agent to the carrier, multimodal transport operator, terminal or other receiving authority, giving information about export consignments offered for transport, and providing for the necessary receipts and declarations of liability. Sometimes a multipurpose cargo handling document also fulfilling the functions of document 632, 633, 650 and 655.

values.name: Forwarder's warehouse receipt
values.description: Forwarder's warehouse receipt Document/message issued by a forwarder acting as Warehouse Keeper acknowledging receipt of goods placed in a warehouse, and stating or referring to the conditions which govern the warehousing and the release of goods. The document contains detailed provisions regarding the rights of holders-by-endorsement, transfer of ownership, etc. E.g. FIATA-FWR.

values.name: Goods receipt
values.description: Goods receipt Document/message to acknowledge the receipt of goods and in addition may indicate receiving conditions.

values.name: Port charges documents
values.description: Port charges documents Documents/messages specifying services rendered, storage and handling costs, demurrage and other charges due to the owner of goods described therein.

values.name: Certified list of ingredients
values.description: Certified list of ingredients A document legalized from a competent authority that shows the components of the product (food additive, detergent, disinfectant and sanitizer).

values.name: Warehouse warrant
values.description: Warehouse warrant Negotiable receipt document, issued by a Warehouse Keeper to a person placing goods in a warehouse and conferring title to the goods stored.

values.name: Health certificate
values.description: Health certificate A document legalized from a competent authority that shows that the product has been tested microbiologically and is free from any pathogens and fit for human consumption and/or declares that the product is in compliance with sanitary and phytosanitary measures.

values.name: Food grade certificate
values.description: Food grade certificate A document that shows that the product (food additive, detergent, disinfectant and sanitizer) is suitable to be used in the food industry.

values.name: Certificate of suitability for transport of grains and
values.description: Certificate of suitability for transport of grains and legumes Certificate of inspection for the vessel stating its readiness and suitability for transporting grains and legumes.

values.name: Certificate of refrigerated transport equipment inspection
values.description: Certificate of refrigerated transport equipment inspection Inspection document shows that the container, the cooling devices and measured temperature is in good working condition.

values.name: Delivery order
values.description: Delivery order Document/message issued by a party entitled to authorize the release of goods specified therein to a named consignee, to be retained by the custodian of the goods.

values.name: Thermographic reading report
values.description: Thermographic reading report A report of temperature readings over a period.

values.name: Certificate of food item transport readiness
values.description: Certificate of food item transport readiness A certificate to verify readiness of a transport or transport area such as a reservoir or hold to transport food items.

values.name: Food packaging contact certificate
values.description: Food packaging contact certificate A document legalized from a competent authority that shows that the food packaging product is safe to come into contact with food.

values.name: Packaging material composition report
values.description: Packaging material composition report A document that shows the main structure that composes the packaging material.

values.name: Export price certificate
values.description: Export price certificate A certification executed by the competent authority from country of exportation stating the export price of the goods.

values.name: Public price certificate
values.description: Public price certificate A certification executed by the competent authority from country of production stating the price of the goods to the general public.

values.name: Drug shelf life study report
values.description: Drug shelf life study report A document containing results from the study which determines the shelf life, namely the time period of storage at a specified condition within which a drug substance or drug product still meets its established specifications; its identity, strength, quality and purity.

values.name: Certificate of compliance with standards of the World
values.description: Certificate of compliance with standards of the World Organization for Animal Health (OIE) A certification that the products have been treated in a way consistent with the standards set by the World Organization for Animal Health (OIE).

values.name: Production facility license
values.description: Production facility license A license granted by a competent authority to a production facility for manufacturing specific products.

values.name: Handling order
values.description: Handling order Document/message issued by a cargo handling organization (port administration, terminal operator, etc.) for the removal or other handling of goods under their care.

values.name: Manufacturing license
values.description: Manufacturing license A license granted by a competent authority to a manufacturer for production of specific products.

values.name: Low risk country formal letter
values.description: Low risk country formal letter An official letter issued by an import authority granted to the importer of goods from a low risk country which allows the importer to place its products in the local market with certain favorable considerations.

values.name: Previous correspondence
values.description: Previous correspondence Correspondence previously exchanged.

values.name: Declaration for radioactive material
values.description: Declaration for radioactive material A declaration to be presented to the competent authority when radioactive material moves cross-border.

values.name: Gate pass
values.description: Gate pass Document/message authorizing goods specified therein to be brought out of a fenced-in port or terminal area.

values.name: Waybill
values.description: Waybill Non-negotiable document evidencing the contract for the transport of cargo.

values.name: Universal (multipurpose) transport document
values.description: Universal (multipurpose) transport document Document/message evidencing a contract of carriage covering the movement of goods by any mode of transport, or combination of modes, for national as well as international transport, under any applicable international convention or national law and under the conditions of carriage of any carrier or transport operator undertaking or arranging the transport referred to in the document.

values.name: Goods receipt, carriage
values.description: Goods receipt, carriage Document/message issued by a carrier or a carrier's agent, acknowledging receipt for carriage of goods specified therein on conditions stated or referred to in the document, enabling the carrier to issue a transport document.

values.name: House waybill
values.description: House waybill The document made out by an agent/consolidator which evidences the contract between the shipper and the agent/consolidator for the arrangement of carriage of goods.

values.name: Master bill of lading
values.description: Master bill of lading A bill of lading issued by the master of a vessel (in actuality the owner or charterer of the vessel). It could cover a number of house bills.

values.name: Bill of lading
values.description: Bill of lading Negotiable document/message which evidences a contract of carriage by sea and the taking over or loading of goods by carrier, and by which carrier undertakes to deliver goods against surrender of the document. A provision in the document that goods are to be delivered to the order of a named person, or to order, or to bearer, constitutes such an undertaking.

values.name: Bill of lading original
values.description: Bill of lading original The original of the bill of lading issued by a transport company. When issued by the maritime industry it could signify ownership of the cargo.

values.name: Bill of lading copy
values.description: Bill of lading copy A copy of the bill of lading issued by a transport company.

values.name: Empty container bill
values.description: Empty container bill Bill of lading indicating an empty container.

values.name: Tanker bill of lading
values.description: Tanker bill of lading Document which evidences a transport of liquid bulk cargo.

values.name: Sea waybill
values.description: Sea waybill Non-negotiable document which evidences a contract for the carriage of goods by sea and the taking over of the goods by the carrier, and by which the carrier undertakes to deliver the goods to the consignee named in the document.

values.name: Inland waterway bill of lading
values.description: Inland waterway bill of lading Negotiable transport document made out to a named person, to order or to bearer, signed by the carrier and handed to the sender after receipt of the goods.

values.name: Non-negotiable maritime transport document (generic)
values.description: Non-negotiable maritime transport document (generic) Non-negotiable document which evidences a contract for the carriage of goods by sea and the taking over or loading of the goods by the carrier, and by which the carrier undertakes to deliver the goods to the consignee named in the document. E.g. Sea waybill. Remark: Synonymous with "straight" or "non-negotiable Bill of lading" used in certain countries, e.g. Canada.

values.name: Mate's receipt
values.description: Mate's receipt Document/message issued by a ship's officer to acknowledge that a specified consignment has been received on board a vessel, and the apparent condition of the goods; enabling the carrier to issue a Bill of lading.

values.name: House bill of lading
values.description: House bill of lading The bill of lading issued not by the carrier but by the freight forwarder/consolidator known by the carrier.

values.name: Letter of indemnity for non-surrender of bill of lading
values.description: Letter of indemnity for non-surrender of bill of lading Document/message issued by a commercial party or a bank of an insurance company accepting responsibility to the beneficiary of the indemnity in accordance with the terms thereof.

values.name: Forwarder's bill of lading
values.description: Forwarder's bill of lading Non-negotiable document issued by a freight forwarder evidencing a contract for the carriage of goods by sea and the taking over or loading of the goods by the freight forwarder, and by which the freight forwarder undertakes to deliver the goods to the consignee named in the document.

values.name: Rail consignment note (generic term)
values.description: Rail consignment note (generic term) Transport document constituting a contract for the carriage of goods between the sender and the carrier (the railway). For international rail traffic, this document must conform to the model prescribed by the international conventions concerning carriage of goods by rail, e.g. CIM Convention, SMGS Convention.

values.name: Road list-SMGS
values.description: Road list-SMGS Accounting document, one copy of which is drawn up for each consignment note; it accompanies the consignment over the whole route and is a rail transport document.

values.name: Escort official recognition
values.description: Escort official recognition Document/message which gives right to the owner to exert all functions normally transferred to a guard in a train by which an escorted consignment is transported.

values.name: Recharging document
values.description: Recharging document Fictitious transport document regarding a previous transport, enabling a carrier's agent to give to another carrier's agent (in a different country) the possibility to collect charges relating to the original transport (rail environment).

values.name: Road consignment note
values.description: Road consignment note Transport document/message which evidences a contract between a carrier and a sender for the carriage of goods by road (generic term). Remark: For international road traffic, this document must contain at least the particulars prescribed by the convention on the contract for the international carriage of goods by road (CMR).

values.name: Air waybill
values.description: Air waybill Document/message made out by or on behalf of the shipper which evidences the contract between the shipper and carrier(s) for carriage of goods over routes of the carrier(s) and which is identified by the airline prefix issuing the document plus a serial (IATA).

values.name: Master air waybill
values.description: Master air waybill Document/message made out by or on behalf of the agent/consolidator which evidences the contract between the agent/consolidator and carrier(s) for carriage of goods over routes of the carrier(s) for a consignment consisting of goods originated by more than one shipper (IATA).

values.name: Substitute air waybill
values.description: Substitute air waybill A temporary air waybill which contains only limited information because of the absence of the original.

values.name: Crew's effects declaration
values.description: Crew's effects declaration Declaration to Customs regarding the personal effects of crew members aboard the conveyance; equivalent to IMO FAL 4.

values.name: Passenger list
values.description: Passenger list Declaration to Customs regarding passengers aboard the conveyance; equivalent to IMO FAL 6.

values.name: Delivery notice (rail transport)
values.description: Delivery notice (rail transport) Document/message created by the consignor or by the departure station, joined to the transport or sent to the consignee, giving the possibility to the consignee or the arrival station to attest the delivery of the goods. The document must be returned to the consignor or to the departure station.

values.name: Despatch note (post parcels)
values.description: Despatch note (post parcels) Document/message which, according to Article 106 of the "Agreement concerning Postal Parcels" under the UPU convention, is to accompany post parcels.

values.name: Multimodal/combined transport document (generic)
values.description: Multimodal/combined transport document (generic) A transport document used when more than one mode of transportation is involved in the movement of cargo. It is a contract of carriage and receipt of the cargo for a multimodal transport. It indicates the place where the responsible transport company in the move takes responsibility for the cargo, the place where the responsibility of this transport company in the move ends and the conveyances involved.

values.name: Through bill of lading
values.description: Through bill of lading Bill of lading which evidences a contract of carriage from one place to another in separate stages of which at least one stage is a sea transit, and by which the issuing carrier accepts responsibility for the carriage as set forth in the through bill of lading.

values.name: Forwarder's certificate of transport
values.description: Forwarder's certificate of transport Negotiable document/message issued by a forwarder to certify that he has taken charge of a specified consignment for despatch and delivery in accordance with the consignor's instructions, as indicated in the document, and that he accepts responsibility for delivery of the goods to the holder of the document through the intermediary of a delivery agent of his choice. E.g. FIATA-FCT.

values.name: Combined transport document (generic)
values.description: Combined transport document (generic) Negotiable or non-negotiable document evidencing a contract for the performance and/or procurement of performance of combined transport of goods and bearing on its face either the heading "Negotiable combined transport document issued subject to Uniform Rules for a Combined Transport Document (ICC Brochure No. 298)" or the heading "Non-negotiable Combined Transport Document issued subject to Uniform Rules for a Combined Transport Document (ICC Brochure No. 298)".

values.name: Multimodal transport document (generic)
values.description: Multimodal transport document (generic) Document/message which evidences a multimodal transport contract, the taking in charge of the goods by the multimodal transport operator, and an undertaking by him to deliver the goods in accordance with the terms of the contract. (International Convention on Multimodal Transport of Goods).

values.name: Combined transport bill of lading/multimodal bill of lading
values.description: Combined transport bill of lading/multimodal bill of lading Document which evidences a multimodal transport contract, the taking in charge of the goods by the multimodal transport operator, and an undertaking by him to deliver the goods in accordance with the terms of the contract.

values.name: Booking confirmation
values.description: Booking confirmation Document/message issued by a carrier to confirm that space has been reserved for a consignment in means of transport.

values.name: Calling forward notice
values.description: Calling forward notice Instructions for release or delivery of goods.

values.name: Freight invoice
values.description: Freight invoice Document/message issued by a transport operation specifying freight costs and charges incurred for a transport operation and stating conditions of payment.

values.name: Arrival notice (goods)
values.description: Arrival notice (goods) Notification from the carrier to the consignee in writing, by telephone or by any other means (express letter, message, telegram, etc.) informing him that a consignment addressed to him is being or will shortly be held at his disposal at a specified point in the place of destination.

values.name: Notice of circumstances preventing delivery (goods)
values.description: Notice of circumstances preventing delivery (goods) Request made by the carrier to the sender, or, as the case may be, the consignee, for instructions as to the disposal of the consignment when circumstances prevent delivery and the return of the goods has not been requested by the consignor in the transport document.

values.name: Notice of circumstances preventing transport (goods)
values.description: Notice of circumstances preventing transport (goods) Request made by the carrier to the sender, or, the consignee as the case may be, for instructions as to the disposal of the goods when circumstances prevent transport before departure or en route, after acceptance of the consignment concerned.

values.name: Delivery notice (goods)
values.description: Delivery notice (goods) Notification in writing, sent by the carrier to the sender, to inform him at his request of the actual date of delivery of the goods.

values.name: Cargo manifest
values.description: Cargo manifest Listing of goods comprising the cargo carried in a means of transport or in a transport-unit. The cargo manifest gives the commercial particulars of the goods, such as transport document numbers, consignors, consignees, shipping marks, number and kind of packages and descriptions and quantities of the goods.

values.name: Freight manifest
values.description: Freight manifest Document/message containing the same information as a cargo manifest, and additional details on freight amounts, charges, etc.

values.name: Bordereau
values.description: Bordereau Document/message used in road transport, listing the cargo carried on a road vehicle, often referring to appended copies of Road consignment note.

values.name: Container manifest (unit packing list)
values.description: Container manifest (unit packing list) Document/message specifying the contents of particular freight containers or other transport units, prepared by the party responsible for their loading into the container or unit.

values.name: Charges note
values.description: Charges note Document used by the rail organization to indicate freight charges or additional charges in each case where the departure station is not able to calculate the charges for the total voyage (e.g. tariff not yet updated, part of voyage not covered by the tariff). This document must be considered as joined to the transport.

values.name: Advice of collection
values.description: Advice of collection (1030) Document that is joined to the transport or sent by separate means, giving to the departure rail organization the proof that the cash-on delivery amount has been encashed by the arrival rail organization before reimbursement of the consignor.

values.name: Safety of ship certificate
values.description: Safety of ship certificate Document certifying a ship's safety to a specified date.

values.name: Safety of radio certificate
values.description: Safety of radio certificate Document certifying the safety of a ship's radio facilities to a specified date.

values.name: Safety of equipment certificate
values.description: Safety of equipment certificate Document certifying the safety of a ship's equipment to a specified date.

values.name: Civil liability for oil certificate
values.description: Civil liability for oil certificate Document declaring a ship owner's liability for oil propelling or carried on a vessel.

values.name: Loadline document
values.description: Loadline document Document specifying the limit of a ship's legal submersion under various conditions.

values.name: Derat document
values.description: Derat document Document certifying that a ship is free of rats, valid to a specified date.

values.name: Maritime declaration of health
values.description: Maritime declaration of health Document certifying the health condition on board a vessel, valid to a specified date.

values.name: Certificate of registry
values.description: Certificate of registry Official certificate stating the vessel's registry.

values.name: Ship's stores declaration
values.description: Ship's stores declaration Declaration to Customs regarding the contents of the ship's stores (equivalent to IMO FAL 3) i.e. goods intended for consumption by passengers/crew on board vessels, aircraft or trains, whether or not sold or landed; goods necessary for operation/maintenance of conveyance, including fuel/lubricants, excluding spare parts/equipment (IMO).

values.name: Export licence, application for
values.description: Export licence, application for Application for a permit issued by a government authority permitting exportation of a specified commodity subject to specified conditions as quantity, country of destination, etc.

values.name: Export licence
values.description: Export licence Permit issued by a government authority permitting exportation of a specified commodity subject to specified conditions as quantity, country of destination, etc. Synonym: Embargo permit.

values.name: Exchange control declaration, export
values.description: Exchange control declaration, export Document/message completed by an exporter/seller as a means whereby the competent body may control that the amount of foreign exchange accrued from a trade transaction is repatriated in accordance with the conditions of payment and exchange control regulations in force.

values.name: Despatch note model T
values.description: Despatch note model T European community transit declaration.

values.name: Despatch note model T1
values.description: Despatch note model T1 Transit declaration for goods circulating under internal community transit procedures (between European Union (EU) countries).

values.name: Despatch note model T2
values.description: Despatch note model T2 Ascertainment that the declared goods were originally produced in an European Union (EU) country.

values.name: Control document T5
values.description: Control document T5 Control document (export declaration) used particularly in case of re-sending without use with only VAT collection, refusal, unconformity with contract etc.

values.name: Re-sending consignment note
values.description: Re-sending consignment note Rail consignment note prepared by the consignor for the facilitation of an eventual return to the origin of the goods.

values.name: Despatch note model T2L
values.description: Despatch note model T2L Ascertainment that the declared goods were originally produced in an European Union (EU) country. May only be used for goods that are loaded on one single means of transport in one single departure point for one single delivery point.

values.name: Goods declaration for exportation
values.description: Goods declaration for exportation Document/message by which goods are declared for export Customs clearance, conforming to the layout key set out at Appendix I to Annex C.1 concerning outright exportation to the Kyoto convention (CCC). Within a Customs union, "for despatch" may have the same meaning as "for exportation".

values.name: Cargo declaration (departure)
values.description: Cargo declaration (departure) Generic term, sometimes referred to as Freight declaration, applied to the documents providing the particulars required by the Customs concerning the cargo (freight) carried by commercial means of transport (CCC).

values.name: Application for goods control certificate
values.description: Application for goods control certificate Document/message submitted to a competent body by party requesting a Goods control certificate to be issued in accordance with national or international standards, or conforming to legislation in the importing country, or as specified in the contract.

values.name: Goods control certificate
values.description: Goods control certificate Document/message issued by a competent body evidencing the quality of the goods described therein, in accordance with national or international standards, or conforming to legislation in the importing country, or as specified in the contract.

values.name: Application for phytosanitary certificate
values.description: Application for phytosanitary certificate Document/message submitted to a competent body by party requesting a Phytosanitary certificate to be issued.

values.name: Phytosanitary certificate
values.description: Phytosanitary certificate Document/message issued by the competent body in the exporting country evidencing that plants, fruit, or vegetables are free from disease and fit for consumption and giving details on fumigation or other treatment to which they may have been subjected.

values.name: Sanitary certificate
values.description: Sanitary certificate Document/message issued by the competent authority in the exporting country evidencing that alimentary and animal products, including dead animals, are fit for human consumption, and giving details, when relevant, of controls undertaken.

values.name: Veterinary certificate
values.description: Veterinary certificate Document/message issued by the competent authority in the exporting country evidencing that live animals or birds are not infested or infected with disease, and giving details regarding their provenance, and of vaccinations and other treatment to which they have been subjected.

values.name: Application for inspection certificate
values.description: Application for inspection certificate Document/message submitted to a competent body by a party requesting an Inspection certificate to be issued in accordance with national or international standards, or conforming to legislation in the country in which it is required, or as specified in the contract.

values.name: Inspection certificate
values.description: Inspection certificate Document/message issued by a competent body evidencing that the goods described therein have been inspected in accordance with national or international standards, in conformity with legislation in the country in which the inspection is required, or as specified in the contract.

values.name: Certificate of origin, application for
values.description: Certificate of origin, application for Document/message submitted to a competent body by an interested party requesting a Certificate of origin to be issued in accordance with relevant criteria, and on the basis of evidence of the origin of the goods.

values.name: Certificate of origin
values.description: Certificate of origin Document/message identifying goods, in which the authority or body authorized to issue it certifies expressly that the goods to which the certificate relates originate in a specific country. The word "country" may include a group of countries, a region or a part of a country. This certificate may also include a declaration by the manufacturer, producer, supplier, exporter or other competent person.

values.name: Declaration of origin
values.description: Declaration of origin Appropriate statement as to the origin of the goods, made in connection with their exportation by the manufacturer, producer, supplier, exporter or other competent person on the Commercial invoice or any other document relating to the goods (CCC).

values.name: Regional appellation certificate
values.description: Regional appellation certificate Certificate drawn up in accordance with the rules laid down by an authority or approved body, certifying that the goods described therein qualify for a designation specific to the given region (e.g. champagne, port wine, Parmesan cheese).

values.name: Preference certificate of origin
values.description: Preference certificate of origin Document/message describing a certificate of origin meeting the requirements for preferential treatment.

values.name: Certificate of origin form GSP
values.description: Certificate of origin form GSP Specific form of certificate of origin for goods qualifying for preferential treatment under the generalized system of preferences (includes a combined declaration of origin and certificate, form A).

values.name: Consular invoice
values.description: Consular invoice Document/message to be prepared by an exporter in his country and presented to a diplomatic representation of the importing country for endorsement and subsequently to be presented by the importer in connection with the import of the goods described therein.

values.name: Dangerous goods declaration
values.description: Dangerous goods declaration (1115) Document/message issued by a consignor in accordance with applicable conventions or regulations, describing hazardous goods or materials for transport purposes, and stating that the latter have been packed and labelled in accordance with the provisions of the relevant conventions or regulations.

values.name: Statistical document, export
values.description: Statistical document, export Document/message in which an exporter provides information about exported goods required by the body responsible for the collection of international trade statistics.

values.name: INTRASTAT declaration
values.description: INTRASTAT declaration Document/message in which a declarant provides information about goods required by the body responsible for the collection of trade statistics.

values.name: Delivery verification certificate
values.description: Delivery verification certificate Document/message whereby an official authority (Customs or governmental) certifies that goods have been delivered.

values.name: Import licence, application for
values.description: Import licence, application for Document/message in which an interested party applies to the competent body for authorization to import either a limited quantity of articles subject to import restrictions, or an unlimited quantity of such articles during a limited period, and specifies the kind of articles, their origin and value, etc.

values.name: Import licence
values.description: Import licence Document/message issued by the competent body in accordance with import regulations in force, by which authorization is granted to a named party to import either a limited quantity of designated articles or an unlimited quantity of such articles during a limited period, under conditions specified in the document.

values.name: Customs declaration without commercial detail
values.description: Customs declaration without commercial detail CUSDEC transmission that does not include data from the commercial detail section of the message.

values.name: Customs declaration with commercial and item detail
values.description: Customs declaration with commercial and item detail CUSDEC transmission that includes data from both the commercial detail and item detail sections of the message.

values.name: Customs declaration without item detail
values.description: Customs declaration without item detail CUSDEC transmission that does not include data from the item detail section of the message.

values.name: Related document
values.description: Related document Document that has a relationship with the stated document/message.

values.name: Receipt (Customs)
values.description: Receipt (Customs) Receipt for Customs duty/tax/fee paid.

values.name: Application for exchange allocation
values.description: Application for exchange allocation Document/message whereby an importer/buyer requests the competent body to allocate an amount of foreign exchange to be transferred to an exporter/seller in payment for goods.

values.name: Foreign exchange permit
values.description: Foreign exchange permit Document/message issued by the competent body authorizing an importer/buyer to transfer an amount of foreign exchange to an exporter/seller in payment for goods.

values.name: Exchange control declaration (import)
values.description: Exchange control declaration (import) Document/message completed by an importer/buyer as a means for the competent body to control that a trade transaction for which foreign exchange has been allocated has been executed and that money has been transferred in accordance with the conditions of payment and the exchange control regulations in force.

values.name: Goods declaration for importation
values.description: Goods declaration for importation Document/message by which goods are declared for import Customs clearance [sister entry of 830].

values.name: Goods declaration for home use
values.description: Goods declaration for home use Document/message by which goods are declared for import Customs clearance according to Annex B.1 (concerning clearance for home use) to the Kyoto convention (CCC).

values.name: Customs immediate release declaration
values.description: Customs immediate release declaration Document/message issued by an importer notifying Customs that goods have been removed from an importing means of transport to the importer's premises under a Customs- approved arrangement for immediate release, or requesting authorization to do so.

values.name: Customs delivery note
values.description: Customs delivery note Document/message whereby a Customs authority releases goods under its control to be placed at the disposal of the party concerned. Synonym: Customs release note.

values.name: Cargo declaration (arrival)
values.description: Cargo declaration (arrival) Generic term, sometimes referred to as Freight declaration, applied to the documents providing the particulars required by the Customs concerning the cargo (freight) carried by commercial means of transport (CCC).

values.name: Value declaration
values.description: Value declaration Document/message in which a declarant (importer) states the invoice or other price (e.g. selling price, price of identical goods), and specifies costs for freight, insurance and packing, etc., terms of delivery and payment, any relationship with the trading partner, etc., for the purpose of determining the Customs value of goods imported.

values.name: Customs invoice
values.description: Customs invoice Document/message required by the Customs in an importing country in which an exporter states the invoice or other price (e.g. selling price, price of identical goods), and specifies costs for freight, insurance and packing, etc., terms of delivery and payment, for the purpose of determining the Customs value in the importing country of goods consigned to that country.

values.name: Customs declaration (post parcels)
values.description: Customs declaration (post parcels) Document/message which, according to Article 106 of the "Agreement concerning Postal Parcels" under the UPU Convention, must accompany post parcels and in which the contents of such parcels are specified.

values.name: Tax declaration (value added tax)
values.description: Tax declaration (value added tax) Document/message in which an importer states the pertinent information required by the competent body for assessment of value-added tax.

values.name: Tax declaration (general)
values.description: Tax declaration (general) Document/message containing a general tax declaration.

values.name: Tax demand
values.description: Tax demand Document/message containing the demand of tax.

values.name: Embargo permit
values.description: Embargo permit Document/message giving the permission to export specified goods.

values.name: Goods declaration for Customs transit
values.description: Goods declaration for Customs transit Document/message by which the sender declares goods for Customs transit according to Annex E.1 (concerning Customs transit) to the Kyoto convention (CCC).

values.name: TIF form
values.description: TIF form International Customs transit document by which the sender declares goods for carriage by rail in accordance with the provisions of the 1952 International Convention to facilitate the crossing of frontiers for goods carried by rail (TIF Convention of UIC).

values.name: TIR carnet
values.description: TIR carnet International Customs document (International Transit by Road), issued by a guaranteeing association approved by the Customs authorities, under the cover of which goods are carried, in most cases under Customs seal, in road vehicles and/or containers in compliance with the requirements of the Customs TIR Convention of the International Transport of Goods under cover of TIR Carnets (UN/ECE).

values.name: EC carnet
values.description: EC carnet EC customs transit document issued by EC customs authorities for transit and/or temporary user of goods within the EC.

values.name: EUR 1 certificate of origin
values.description: EUR 1 certificate of origin Customs certificate used in preferential goods interchanges between EC countries and EC external countries.

values.name: ATA carnet
values.description: ATA carnet International Customs document (Admission Temporaire / Temporary Admission) which, issued under the terms of the ATA Convention (1961), incorporates an internationally valid guarantee and may be used, in lieu of national Customs documents and as security for import duties and taxes, to cover the temporary admission of goods and, where appropriate, the transit of goods. If accepted for controlling the temporary export and reimport of goods, international guarantee does not apply (CCC).

values.name: Single administrative document
values.description: Single administrative document A set of documents, replacing the various (national) forms for Customs declaration within the EC, implemented on 01-01-1988.

values.name: General response (Customs)
values.description: General response (Customs) General response message to permit the transfer of data from Customs to the transmitter of the previous message.

values.name: Document response (Customs)
values.description: Document response (Customs) Document response message to permit the transfer of data from Customs to the transmitter of the previous message.

values.name: Error response (Customs)
values.description: Error response (Customs) Error response message to permit the transfer of data from Customs to the transmitter of the previous message.

values.name: Package response (Customs)
values.description: Package response (Customs) Package response message to permit the transfer of data from Customs to the transmitter of the previous message.

values.name: Tax calculation/confirmation response (Customs)
values.description: Tax calculation/confirmation response (Customs) Tax calculation/confirmation response message to permit the transfer of data from Customs to the transmitter of the previous message.

values.name: Quota prior allocation certificate
values.description: Quota prior allocation certificate Document/message issued by the competent body for prior allocation of a quota.

values.name: Wagon report
values.description: Wagon report Document which contains consignment information concerning the wagons and their lading in a case of a multiple wagon consignment.

values.name: Transit Conveyor Document
values.description: Transit Conveyor Document Document for a course of transit used for a carrier who is neither the carrier at the beginning nor the arrival. The transit carrier can directly invoice the expenses for its part of the transport.

values.name: Rail consignment note forwarder copy
values.description: Rail consignment note forwarder copy Document which is a copy of the rail consignment note printed especially for the need of the forwarder.

values.name: Duty suspended goods
values.description: Duty suspended goods Document giving details for the carriage of excisable goods on a duty-suspended basis.

values.name: Proof of transit declaration
values.description: Proof of transit declaration A document providing proof that a transit declaration has been accepted.

values.name: Container transfer note
values.description: Container transfer note Document for the carriage of containers. Syn: transfer note.

values.name: NATO transit document
values.description: NATO transit document Customs transit document for the carriage of shipments of the NATO armed forces under Customs supervision.

values.name: Transfrontier waste shipment authorization
values.description: Transfrontier waste shipment authorization Document containing the authorization from the relevant authority for the international carriage of waste. Syn: Transfrontier waste shipment permit.

values.name: Transfrontier waste shipment movement document
values.description: Transfrontier waste shipment movement document Document certified by the carriers and the consignee to be used for the international carriage of waste.

values.name: End use authorization
values.description: End use authorization Document issued by Customs granting the end-use Customs procedure.

values.name: Government contract
values.description: Government contract Document/message describing a contract with a government authority.

values.name: Statistical document, import
values.description: Statistical document, import Document/message describing an import document that is used for statistical purposes.

values.name: Application for documentary credit
values.description: Application for documentary credit Message with application for opening of a documentary credit.

values.name: Previous Customs document/message
values.description: Previous Customs document/message Indication of the previous Customs document/message concerning the same transaction.
